name: A turn of a few minutes gets a face but leaves the mood alone
case: Two turns of a few minutes each finish well, one with passing tests, the second Codex's, which Boop treats as it would Claude's. Each finish gets a pleased face, held once or twice, played as a success, but nothing bigger, since neither stands out. Boop stays calm, follows the work (engaged) while it goes on, or is a little glad (happy) at a long turn's hard work done, never more.
gap: Jev sometimes plays a few minutes' turn done, its tests passing, as a big moment, held three times (1 or 2 of 3 runs, 2026-11-01), where PERSONALITY's Example says small or medium. A firmer Example, or a size the turn's band sets in code, would fix it.
why: character/steering/mood/calm.md: calm stays through routine finishes, even a few minutes long, since only a very long turn (5 minutes or more) finishing done lifts it; it may follow a long turn, engaged, at a check-in; PERSONALITY's Examples: a turn of a minute or more finishing done gets a happy face and its success, small or medium, and the 2nd quick win of a streak a pleased one; mood/calm.md: calm leaves for happy at a long turn's hard work done. The view lines Codex's hooks as Claude's (agent-hooks' Mapping.codex), and Codex never says a turn failed
